Jensen Huang says he loves working with Elon Musk

And he explains why.

Musk uses Nvidia's technology three ways at once.

Training his own AI models.

Deploying them, like Grok, where demand is skyrocketing.

And renting it out.

Very few companies do all three.

Musk also loves the place where computing meets the physical build-out.

Jensen: "Nobody knows more about energy than he does."

So they went after a new market together.

Data centers in space.

Their two engineering teams were working super closely to create a new type of server.

A new architecture that might work great in space, and on Earth.
